s-1.ptxt: Function Inspection when Cold (Engine Coolant Temperature 83°C or Less)

s2.ptxt: Check that the fan does not rotate when the ignition switch is turned ON with the A/C switch OFF.
Disconnect the E.F.I. water temperature connector.
Check that the fan rotates when the ignition switch is turned ON.

s-1.ptxt: Function Inspection when Hot (Engine Coolant Temperature 96°C or Higher)

s2.ptxt: After warming up the engine, check that the A/C switch is OFF.
Check that the fan starts rotating when the coolant temperature reaches 96°C or more, and stops when it falls to approximately 94.5°C or less.

item.ptxt: The fan is controlled by the engine control computer.
The engine coolant temperature can be checked with "ECU Data Monitor" of SST (TaSCAN).
